breakthrough: New products can be assembled from reusable business primitives
lane: Business operations and commercial behavior fabric
outcome: Compose sellable offers from capabilities, service levels, pricing, and delivery capacity

phases.name: Phase 1 - Build the Offer Assembly Fabric Core

subphases.name: 1.1 Offer Assembly Fabric Domain Model and State Plane
work: Define typed services, routes, resources, events, and placement state required to compose sellable offers from capabilities, service levels, pricing, and delivery capacity, with explicit versions and validation at every boundary.

Implement an owned persistent state layer optimized for customers, offers, resources, operations, pricing, service delivery, and real-time business decisions; include snapshots or event history when state changes over time.
Expose create, query, update, subscribe, and delete operations through local APIs plus an SDK that never requires private cross-runtime imports.

subphases.name: 1.2 Offer Assembly Fabric Execution Runtime
work: Build resumable workers and state machines that perform the core operation: compose sellable offers from capabilities, service levels, pricing, and delivery capacity.
Add cancellation, idempotency, bounded retries, timeouts, quotas, sandbox limits, and deterministic recovery from partial failure.
Create a local simulator that can replay success, malformed inputs, disconnection, overload, provider loss, and restart recovery.

phases.name: Phase 2 - Make Offer Assembly Fabric Adaptive and Usable

subphases.name: 2.1 Offer Assembly Fabric Decision and Learning Engine
work: Implement scoring, planning, prediction, search, or optimization using forecasting, optimization, simulation, recommendation, and anomaly detection.
Create feedback signals from task outcomes and user corrections; update tunable behavior without silently changing hard safety limits.
Return confidence, alternatives, bottlenecks, and a concise machine-readable explanation for every important automated choice.

subphases.name: 2.2 Offer Assembly Fabric Interaction Surface
work: Build the primary experience in the business twin, unit-economics dashboard, offer composer, and deal cockpit, including live state, controls, errors, and recovery actions.
Add a CLI and typed client library so humans, agents, games, and third-party applications can operate the capability directly.
Stream progress and intermediate artifacts in real time so long operations remain inspectable, interruptible, and steerable.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Scale Offer Assembly Fabric into a Breakthrough Product

subphases.name: 3.1 Offer Assembly Fabric Offline, Edge, and Cloud Mesh
work: Implement local-only, hybrid, and cloud execution with explicit capability discovery and graceful behavior when optional peers disappear.
Add conflict-safe synchronization, workload placement, caching, backpressure, and failover across devices or nodes where the feature benefits from distribution.
Benchmark latency, throughput, memory, energy, network transfer, and cost; make the scheduler choose the best execution mode from measured constraints.

subphases.name: 3.2 Offer Assembly Fabric Signature Breakthrough
work: Implement the differentiating behavior: New products can be assembled from reusable business primitives. Ship it as an opt-in executable mode, not a mockup.
Run adversarial, load, privacy, misuse, degraded-network, and recovery tests against the novel behavior; block unsafe automatic actions.
Package the feature as an independently installable capability with a live demo, sample integration, metrics endpoint, and rollback-safe release artifact.
